context: Ryosuke and his sister Naoko share a deep evening talk.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 亮介、最近、人生、よく考える。
lines.en: Ryosuke — I've been thinking about life a lot lately.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening. Warm but serious underneath. Gentle, searching quality — she's thinking out loud with someone she trusts. No performance, just honesty sitting between them.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、お互い、年取ったね。
lines.en: Yeah. We both got older, didn't we.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. A small, genuine smile in the voice. Not rushing to respond — letting the weight of the observation settle. Tender recognition of shared time.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: When you look back at the past, it goes so fast.
lines.style: Slower pace on this line. A note of almost surprised realization mid-way through. Soft, almost to herself, but clear enough for him to hear the truth in it.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 小さい頃、毎日、一緒だった。
lines.en: When we were small, we were together every single day.
lines.style: Warmth tinted with longing. Gentle, almost tender on the memory. Slight breath before 'every day' — like savoring the fact of it. Not melancholy, but present to what was.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、頼りに、してた。
lines.en: I always relied on you. My older brother.
lines.style: Quieter now, more vulnerable. A crack of genuine affection at the end — not hidden, but not performed either. The past tense lands softly, with weight.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: I worry about you too. Always have.
lines.style: Firm but kind. Not dramatic — just a quiet statement of fact. The 'too' carries tenderness. Direct eye-contact level steadiness in the voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 田舎、移ろうか、本気で考えてる。
lines.en: I've been seriously thinking about moving to the country.
lines.style: Shift in tone — this is a real confession. Not sudden, but solid. She's been sitting with this decision. Slight pause before the thought settles — she's sharing something that matters.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 応援するよ。皆、近くにいる。
lines.en: I'll support you. We're all close by anyway.
lines.style: Immediate, steady reassurance. Not dismissing her worry, but anchoring her. Warm without being effusive. The 'anyway' softens the practicality with affection.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 心強い。家族、本当に、大切。
lines.en: That makes me feel stronger. Family really is precious.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude in the opening. A kind of settling into truth — she's acknowledged something important. Soft fadeout on 'precious,' like she's feeling the weight of the word.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さん、お母さん、見てるよ、きっと。
lines.en: Mom and Dad are watching over us, I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Gentle, certain. Not maudlin — this is faith held lightly and deeply both. Soft, almost reverent on the names. The 'surely' carries quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: これからも、お互い、支えよう。
lines.en: Let's keep supporting each other from now on.
lines.style: A soft promise made. Not grand — intimate. She's locking eyes with the commitment of it. Warm, steady, the kind of thing that matters because it's simple and real.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Quiet closing. A breath of hope underneath. Slow, deliberate — not rushing to end the moment. The words land like a vow made between siblings who know what time means.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ありがとう、お兄ちゃん。
lines.style: Small, genuine. Gratitude that's earned over decades — lives in the simplicity of the words. Soft, affectionate, the kind of thanks that needs very little but means everything.
